generation.explanation: Start with a unit square (area 1). Fill half of it (1/2), then half of what's left (1/4), then half of the remainder (1/8), and so on. Each step covers half of the remaining empty space, so the uncovered area shrinks toward zero and the filled pieces add up to the whole square: 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/8 + ... = 1. Use the slider to add more pieces and watch the gap shrink.
